body: Fix failing test `test_salt_treatment_emergency_scenario` in `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_chloride_protection.rs`. The `salt_treatment_source_profile()` helper constructs a `SourceWaterProfile` by copying DIC and alkalinity concentrations from the tank state, but the resulting DIC/alkalinity combination produces a pH that fails `validate_source_water_carbonate_profile()` with `InvalidSourceProfile { field: "carbonate_derived_ph", value: 8.5 }`. The source profile needs its DIC and alkalinity values adjusted (or a valid carbonate equilibrium explicitly set) so the profile passes validation when inserted into the source water catalog.
